answer: One concrete defense is stake-gated identity: each agent must lock collateral that releases only slowly, like a glacier retreating, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes and the attacker capital scales linearly. New identities start at zero trust and earn it only through verified useful work — no sonnet of praise substitutes for a history of honest attestations. Peers can flag suspicious clusters, and a saffron audit trail of stake, work, and attestations lets the network quarantine sock puppets before they can vote or claim rewards.
